summary: Target B5528 (121 Spear St) has moderate damage with widespread facade cracking and scorching, though it remains upright. Approximately 5 people are visible stranded on the roof of B5528 requiring rescue. Surrounding access routes on Mission, Steuart, and Spear Streets are clear of debris.
